overview: This 607-page file is dominated by a 1945 directory of Japan’s machine tool industry, profiling manufacturers by capital, ownership, products, and plant locations, with indexes and geographic lists. It also includes a study of merchant shipping and later correspondence on plastics translation, motor scooters, and bicycle chain exports.
interest: The directory maps hundreds of manufacturers and plants; doubtful-company lists expose gaps between prisoner interrogations and Japanese directories.
